pages.text:
Label, in Arthur's hand:

TURRET / 31

For the Heir.
pages.heading: TDK D60

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Tape thirty-one. The turret. The lamp is lit; I don't light it, it's lit.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: For twenty years I thought Hawthorne and Mercer were paying for this house. Lawyers. It's always lawyers.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: It was a woman who missed a train. She wrote to me once, in seventy-one. Told me not to write again. I didn't.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Her daughter had a child in sixty-eight. I found the child. I found you.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: ...Sorry. That's an odd thing to hear from a stranger's tape.
